title: Dr. Seinyor's Birthday Cake Caper
synopsis: The show opens with house rules from the cast before diving into chaos: Stacey whips up a birthday cake for Dr. Seinyor using suspiciously mixed 'potions' (really barbecue sauce and invisible milk) that turn into soup instead of pie. Meanwhile a frantic hotline call comes in warning that 'Ultimate Evil' -- the evil brother -- has returned for revenge, wielding the soul of Makuta. The gang scrambles to finish dinner and rush out to face him.

title: Enter the Toa Nuva and the Punch Buddies
synopsis: A special-report cutaway introduces the newest recruits to the Super Family: the six Toa Nuva, plus three Volkswagen New Beetles nicknamed the Punch Buddies -- Blackie, Barry, and Ruby. Battle resumes against the evil brother and Makuta, with heroes trading tail-and-head grabs, tennis-racket bombs, and boasts about unleashing their 'most powerful attacks.'

title: Tickles, Confusion, and Solar Beams
synopsis: The toy battle rolls on with a heavy dose of silliness -- a fighter gets reduced to giggles by a tickle attack before finally getting into position, while Pokemon-style moves like Confusion and Hyper get called out alongside a home-brewed 'solarize' beam meant to knock a foe out cold. Makuta gets accused of turning an enemy into a cartoon, and the narrator keeps interrupting to remind everyone about their forgotten most-powerful-attacks.

title: Cowboy Gear and the Cartoon Curse
synopsis: Combat gets weirder as one fighter suits up in cowboy gear for a 'wicked ride' while enemies keep getting hit with a move that turns them into literal, flickering cartoons. After trading taunts and a bazooka gag, the exhausted heroes declare the villains defeated and settle in to make camp for the night.

title: Shark Claw, Lightsabers, and Sheila's Accent
synopsis: A winged villain called Shark Claw squares off against the heroes, who counter with a lightsaber ('better than any old sword') and a mask of strength. A running bit has one character putting on a fake Australian accent as 'Sheila,' while the Powerpuff Girls make a surprise cameo, joining the fight with a taste-test gag before everyone unleashes their most powerful attacks.

title: The Rowdy Ruff Boys Crash the Fight
synopsis: The battle expands as the Rowdy Ruff Boys jump in against the heroes, trading boasts about being 'more powerful' than Makuta and the evil brother. A parade of goofy attack names -- Hyper Ray, Confusion, Beak Beam -- fly back and forth before the segment ends on a newcomer wielding a lightsaber.

title: Eagle Art Overload
synopsis: A dialogue-heavy but hard-to-follow stretch dominated by dozens of repeated 'Eagle Art' attack calls, tangled trash talk, and in-jokes about earlier Super Family movies. The transcript is unusually garbled here, but the gist is a chaotic multi-way battle building toward another most-powerful-attack showdown.

title: The One-on-One Chrono Duel
synopsis: Two fighters break off into a one-on-one battle, trading blows and boasts about their fencing training. Between rounds the kids bicker about a barrage of overly personal questions, and someone nurses a case of the hiccups after burning through two 'Chrono' power tokens in a row.

title: The Purple Chrono Swap
synopsis: Fighters burn through their Chrono resources one by one, squabbling over who gets the last swords and snacks. A running gag has Makuta ordering a favorite purple Chrono handed over against its owner's will, while a fire beam and a 'meanies must be destroyed' taunt round out the skirmish.

title: Super Pohatu Takes Flight
synopsis: One fighter discovers new claw weapons and declares himself 'Super Pohatu,' floating and scraping his way through a lighthearted scuffle full of poking, a soccer-ball head gag, and a rescued mask. The action winds down with the group resting after finally catching up to some 'big fat slowpokes.'

title: Pohatu's Gold Mask Gambit
synopsis: Pohatu digs up an old gold mask mid-battle and puts it back on for a fresh round of ground-beam attacks and underground ambush tactics. Lewa gets launched clean across the field, and the team debates whether to charge in or wait before regrouping.

title: Gally's Fire Staff and the Voice Box Caper
synopsis: Gally wields a fire staff while the group needles Makuta with a bit about swapping his voice box to make him 'sound like a girl.' Fighters cycle through pickety sticks, meditation breaks, and a running gag insisting that laughing is 'very good for your body,' before the mysterious XO Toa gets destroyed and the crew retreats to make pancakes.

title: Dr. Seinyor's Lightsaber Duel
synopsis: After a shish-kebab attack and a joke about Lewa being 'born four years ago on Christmas,' Dr. Seinyor announces he'll settle things with the evil brother in a personal lightsaber duel modeled on a Star Wars Jedi Power Battles clip, while the Toa Nuva handle Makuta. The evil brother bolts and leads Dr. Seinyor on a chase across hyper-jumps and an elevator before the Toa Nuva's fight resumes with Onua Nuva stepping up to battle.

title: Onua Nuva's New Arm Weapon
synopsis: The Toa Nuva fight continues as Onua Nuva steps up to battle, showing off a new arm weapon and mismatched leg gear before launching into hyper slashes and a soccer-style super kick. A sword duel follows, complete with a broken blade, repeated meditation breaks, and a running joke about strength and weakness being someone's 'temper.'

title: The Super Family's Final Stand
synopsis: The battle wraps up on the beach as the villain finally goes down for good, sputtering through a dramatic final-defeat speech before the credits roll. The episode closes out the movie with a teaser for the next Super Family video, promising it will be the longest one yet.

title: Stacey's Early Homecoming
synopsis: The eighth Super Family movie kicks off with house rules read by Amanda Young and opening credits naming Adam Young as director. The story follows Stacey coming home from college unexpectedly early, juggling phone calls, invisible bus fare, curtain-hiding from 'evil,' and looking after baby Sam and baby Jessica amid a peanut-butter mishap.

title: Silent Battle Stretch
synopsis: A mostly silent stretch of stop-motion battle action, with no narrated dialogue captured in this segment.

title: A Dropped Car and a Few Words
synopsis: Only a handful of stray lines were captured here -- a quick exchange about getting out of a chamber and dropping something -- inside what is otherwise a dialogue-light stretch of action.

title: The Quiet Battlefield

title: Wavy Fingers and the Stinger Strike
synopsis: A quick burst of battle narration catches one fighter landing a devastating power move and a stinger strike so strong it stops the opponent cold. The narrator excitedly calls out immobilizing attacks and teases another fight still rolling on, before the recording cuts off mid-sentence. Short and scrappy, more toy-clash chaos than clear plot.

title: The Krona Switcheroo
synopsis: The heroes run desperately low on Krona, their spent power-masks, spitting them out and hoarding them, and even bluffing with an empty backup mask just in case Makuta's influence turns them again. A running gag interrupts the fight for a stern kids-don't-smoke PSA about a cigar-shaped mask piece. Loyalties blur into total confusion over who's evil now, until a booming voice cuts through the noise to remind everyone who the real enemy is.

title: Pea Brains and the Last Krona
synopsis: Makuta faces off again with no introductions needed this time, both sides scrambling to reload their very last Krona before the fight even starts. Between fireball charge-ups and a mask getting knocked clean off, the narrators bicker over whether "pea" is smart and whether a secret code might give the game away. It ends on a cliffhanger shout as Makuta declares himself very much alive.

title: Halftime with Stacy Senor
synopsis: The battle grinds on with masks and shields flying until the show abruptly cuts to a mock "Sports Center" halftime segment. A deadpan reporter interviews Stacy Senor about the ongoing eighth movie's battle, gets a shrug and a "good luck, make sure you win," then teases a "Stacy's Magical Moments" segment before technical difficulties send viewers off to find the ninth movie.
